**Implementation note:** Bollinger bands are the rolling mean plus or minus k standard deviations; the trade uses the W-bottom pattern.

## Description

Standardize deviation from a rolling mean and trade extreme positive/negative z-scores toward the mean.

## Where it may fit

Stationary or locally mean-reverting price/spread series.

## Vehicles

Pairs, ETF spreads, FX, futures spreads; individual stocks only with caution.

## Required data

Synchronized prices, rolling mean/std, stationarity checks, costs and borrow if short.

## Caveats

A moving mean is not guaranteed to be an equilibrium; regime shifts make z-scores misleading.
